concepts.title: Ashen expanse
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: a NEW standalone art-direction image of an explorable jigsaw puzzle map for the dark fantasy game Dice and Destiny.
Input image role: The supplied battle-screen image is a STYLE AND COLOR REFERENCE ONLY. Study its grim ink illustration, watercolor shading, stained paper texture, bone and ash colors, deep charcoal blacks, aged parchment, tiny warm lantern lights, muted dried-blood burgundy, and desaturated sickly greens. Do not reproduce its composition, battle, characters, user interface, dice, cards, text or health bars. This is a new overhead exploration map in that game's visual language.
Primary subject: an irregular branching map built from 6–9 connected thick JIGSAW PUZZLE terrain pieces, with unmistakable large rounded knobs and complementary circular sockets on a square cardinal grid. Precise narrow jigsaw seams remain visible between JOINED pieces; adjacent knobs fit into matching sockets with no overlaps. Clear paths cross joins north/south/east/west. Exposed outer jigsaw tabs and empty space suggest undiscovered routes. Environment art and modest raised scenic landmarks live on the upper surfaces, with low/cutaway walls and open centers for readability.
A single original dark-fantasy explorer miniature stands on its own CLEARLY VISIBLE raised circular black beveled wargaming base sitting ON TOP OF one tile. The miniature is much smaller than the tile, a movable pawn rather than a life-sized person. Bone-colored worn clothes, black ragged cloak, small amber lantern, scavenged equipment. Render the miniature in the same hand-painted illustration style.
Show one new matching terrain puzzle piece hovering in a controlled vertical descent over an EMPTY destination cell at the board's exposed edge. It has a compatible tab/socket silhouette and aligns to the cardinal grid. Fine falling dust or watercolor wisps, shadow beneath, restrained warm ivory/amber light at the receiving connector express that it is about to lock into place. Keep the empty destination cell truly empty, not a second solid tile beneath it. A few recently joined seams faintly glow. No exploded view: all other pieces are already attached.
Style: mature bleak DARK FANTASY INK AND WATERCOLOR CONCEPT PAINTING, delicately drawn architectural and terrain detail, irregular dry brush, granular wash, soaked edges, ink hatching, distressed paper. Authored painterly 2.5D illustration with selective terrain relief, not a shiny CGI render, not a toy photograph, not cute or colorful, not cartoon. Preserve the reference's harsh elegant contrast and eerie lonely atmosphere. Let environment identity change while palette remains restrained.
Framing: standalone landscape 3:2 image, elevated three-quarter camera to read the entire map and circular pawn base; full board and airborne tile within frame with generous margin, readable puzzle contours against near-black ink wash and parchment haze. No HUD, no captions, no writing, no arrows, no watermark, no panels, no image collage. No saturated rainbow colors, blue magical neon, glossy plastics, gold decorative borders, or full-size battle scene.

Specific terrain and layout for this new standalone concept:
Scene: fractured chalk-gray wasteland and thin jagged black stone needles, closely related in atmosphere to the reference but seen as an entirely new puzzle exploration board. Broad four-way crossing tile at center, a short northern branch toward a ruined doorway, western shrine, southern lantern rest station, eastern discovery. On the tile surfaces, pale cracked sediment, black rock splinters, a tiny shelter made from torn ivory cloth. The incoming eastern piece carries a desolate pass and two lanterns. Bone, charcoal, desaturated warm gray, one tiny faded crimson ribbon. Low relief so the jigsaw forms read clearly.
